# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

## - Loading libraries

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(R.utils)
library(gridExtra)
library(scDblFinder)
library(Biostrings)
library(Rsamtools)
library(showtext)
```

## - Defining input data and output directories

```{r}
data_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Data/10x')
results_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Results/10x')
Input_data = paste(data_folder, '/Per_Sample_Demultiplexed_Mapped_Data', sep = '')

dir.create(path = paste(results_folder, '/VDJ', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)
```

## - Loading palettes

```{r}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)
library(yarrr, quietly = TRUE)
library(scales, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggsci, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package
mix_1 <- usecol(pal = c(Karpfenblau, "white", Peach), n = 15)
mix_2 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_seeblau), "white", pal_pinky))
mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages
brew_mix <- usecol(c(rev(brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Reds")), "white", brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Blues")), n = 13)
brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)
yarrr_mix <- usecol(c(piratepal("nemo"), piratepal("bugs")))
yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

gradient_exp <- rev(c('#FFAB01', '#FC8805', '#FC5D05', '#D92211', "#D9043D", "#A6036D", "#7C038C", "#5503A6", "#A69AEE", '#D9D4F7', "#FFFFFF", "#F4F7FF", '#E9EBEF'))

# Display the second set of custom palettes
seecol(pal = list(brew_mix, brew_ext, yarrr_mix, yarrr_mod), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 2, title = "Using usecol() and seecol() to mix and modify palettes", pal_names = c("brew_mix", "brew_ext", "yarrr_mix", "yarrr_mod"))

# Define additional custom palettes from the scales package
natjournals_palette <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
```

## - UMAP ALL by celltype

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

cols <- c(
  "Naive B-cells"                 = "#E15759",
  "Transitional B-cells"          = "#EDC948",
  "Atypical memory B-cells"       = "#F28E2B",
  "IgM memory B-cells"            = "#76B7B2",
  "Class switched memory B-cells" = "#4E79A7",
  "CD4+ T-cells"                  = "#9C755F",
  "CD8+ T-cells"                  = "#BAB0AC",
  "NK cells"                      = "#59A14F",
  "CD14+ monocytes"               = "#FF9DA7",
  "CD16+ monocytes"               = "#B07AA1",
  "Dendritic cells"               = "#B6992D"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Base plot (WITH legend)
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_base <- SCpubr::do_DimPlot(
  Merged.SeuratObj,
  reduction   = "h_umap",
  group.by    = "Celltype",
  border.size = 2,
  pt.size     = 1
) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, breaks = names(cols)) +
  xlab("UMAP-1") + ylab("UMAP-2") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  ggtitle(
    label = "Integrated",
    subtitle = paste0("N = ", ncol(Merged.SeuratObj))
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      ncol = 3,
      override.aes = list(
        shape  = 21,
        fill   = unname(cols),
        colour = "black",
        stroke = 0.8,
        size   = 3
      )
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# No-legend version
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_nolegend <- plot_base +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Save WITH legend
# --------------------------------------------------

png(
  filename = paste0(results_folder,
                    "/Phenotype/UMAP_ALL_coloured_by_celltype_WITH_legend.png"),
  width = 9*0.75,
  height = 11*0.75,
  res = 300,
  units = "in",
  type = "cairo"
)
print(plot_base)
dev.off()

pdf(
  file = paste0(results_folder,
                "/Phenotype/UMAP_ALL_coloured_by_celltype_WITH_legend.pdf"),
  width = 9*0.75,
  height = 11*0.75
)
print(plot_base)
dev.off()

# --------------------------------------------------
# Save WITHOUT legend
# --------------------------------------------------

png(
  filename = paste0(results_folder,
                    "/Phenotype/UMAP_ALL_coloured_by_celltype_NO_legend.png"),
  width = 9*0.70,
  height = 9*0.75,
  res = 300,
  units = "in",
  type = "cairo"
)
print(plot_nolegend)
dev.off()

pdf(
  file = paste0(results_folder,
                "/Phenotype/UMAP_ALL_coloured_by_celltype_NO_legend.pdf"),
  width = 9*0.70,
  height = 9*0.75
)
print(plot_nolegend)
dev.off()

```

## - UMAP ALL by donors individual

```{r}
cols <- c(
  "VA013_T5"           = "skyblue",
  "VA013_T8"           = "steelblue4",
  "VA022_T5"           = "sandybrown",
  "VA022_T8"           = "darkorange1",
  "VA025_T5"           = "lightgreen",
  "VA025_T8"           = "forestgreen",
  "VA035_T5"           = "gold1",
  "VA035_T8"           = "gold4",
  "VA038_T5"           = "lightseagreen",
  "VA038_T8"           = "turquoise4",
  "VA059_T5"           = "indianred1",
  "VA059_T8"           = "brown3"
)

library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

# Get UMAP embeddings
umap_embeddings <- as.data.frame(
  Merged.SeuratObj@reductions[["h_umap"]]@cell.embeddings
)

colnames(umap_embeddings)[1:2] <- c("humap_1", "humap_2")
umap_embeddings$cell <- rownames(umap_embeddings)

# Add Donor_timepoint
md <- Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data
umap_embeddings$Donor_timepoint <- md[umap_embeddings$cell, "Donor_timepoint"]

# Output dir
outdir <- file.path(results_folder, "Phenotype", "UMAP_by_Donor_timepoint")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Levels to iterate
donors <- sort(unique(na.omit(umap_embeddings$Donor_timepoint)))

# Safety check
missing_cols <- setdiff(donors, names(cols))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  warning(
    "These Donor_timepoint levels are missing in cols:\n",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Loop
for (d in donors) {

  message("Plotting: ", d)

  selected_cells <- umap_embeddings[
    umap_embeddings$Donor_timepoint == d,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  n_sel <- nrow(selected_cells)
  n_tot <- nrow(umap_embeddings)
  pct   <- round((n_sel / n_tot) * 100, 2)

  # Get colour (fallback to grey if missing)
  col_use <- if (d %in% names(cols)) cols[d] else "#999999"

  plot <- ggplot() +

    # Background
    geom_point(
      data = umap_embeddings,
      aes(humap_1, humap_2),
      color = "#d6d6d6",
      alpha = 0.3,
      size = 1
    ) +

    # Highlight
    geom_point(
      data = selected_cells,
      aes(humap_1, humap_2),
      shape  = 21,
      fill   = col_use,
      colour = "black",
      stroke = 0.4,
      size   = 1.7,
      alpha  = 0.95
    ) +

    theme_void() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    ) +

    ggtitle(
      d,
      paste0(n_sel, " cells (", pct, "%)")
    )

  # Safe filename
  fname <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]", "_", d)

  # PNG
  png(
    file.path(outdir, paste0("UMAP_Highlighted_", fname, ".png")),
    width = 9*0.70,
    height = 9*0.75,
    res = 300,
    units = "in",
    type = "cairo"
  )
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # PDF
  pdf(
    file.path(outdir, paste0("UMAP_Highlighted_", fname, ".pdf")),
    width = 9*0.70,
    height = 9*0.75
  )
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
}
```

## - Donor_timepoints distribution across celltypes

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(ggprism)
library(grid)   # for unit()

# Colours
fillscols <- c(
  "VA013_T5" = "skyblue",
  "VA013_T8" = "steelblue4",
  "VA022_T5" = "sandybrown",
  "VA022_T8" = "darkorange1",
  "VA025_T5" = "lightgreen",
  "VA025_T8" = "forestgreen",
  "VA035_T5" = "gold1",
  "VA035_T8" = "gold4",
  "VA038_T5" = "lightseagreen",
  "VA038_T8" = "turquoise4",
  "VA059_T5" = "indianred1",
  "VA059_T8" = "brown3"
)

# Counts per Celltype × Donor_timepoint
df <- Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Celltype), !is.na(Donor_timepoint)) %>%
  count(Celltype, Donor_timepoint, name = "n")

# True totals per Celltype (from raw cells)
totals <- Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Celltype)) %>%
  count(Celltype, name = "total")

# Join totals + compute % within each Celltype
df <- df %>%
  left_join(totals, by = "Celltype") %>%
  group_by(Celltype) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Keep legend/stack order consistent
df$Donor_timepoint <- factor(df$Donor_timepoint, levels = rev(names(fillscols)))

# One row per Celltype for labels
df_labels <- df %>% distinct(Celltype, total)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Celltype, y = pct, fill = Donor_timepoint)) +
  geom_col(
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  # n labels (outside panel; keep axis 0–100)
  geom_text(
    data = df_labels,
    aes(
      x = Celltype,
      y = 103,
      label = paste0("n = ", total)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3.8,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = fillscols,
    breaks = names(fillscols),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    oob = scales::oob_keep,   # IMPORTANT: do not drop y > 100 labels
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = "Donor timepoint"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  theme_prism(
    palette = "muted_rainbow",
    base_size = 14,
    base_line_size = 1
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    # Increase right margin so "n =" labels fit; adjust 60->40/80 as needed
    plot.margin = margin(10, 60, 10, 10),
    # Tighten legend spacing a bit
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 3,               # more rows = less width
      byrow = TRUE,
      keywidth = unit(0.8, "cm"),
      keyheight = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      override.aes = list(
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.6,
        stroke = 1
      )
    )
  )

  # PNG
  png(
    file.path(results_folder,
              paste0("/Phenotype/Donor_timepoint_distribution_over_celltypes.png")),
    width = 2.73*3.25,
    height = 1.65*3.4,
    res = 300,
    units = "in",
    type = "cairo"
  )
  print(p)
  dev.off()

  # PDF
  pdf(
    file.path(results_folder,
              paste0("/Phenotype/Donor_timepoint_distribution_over_celltypes.pdf")),
    width = 2.73*3.25,
    height = 1.65*3.4
  )
  print(p)
  dev.off()

```

## - UMAP ALL colour by GEX and GEX+VDJ

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj$Has_VDJ <- ifelse(
  is.na(Merged.SeuratObj$clone_id),
  "GEX",
  "GEX+VDJ"
)

Merged.SeuratObj$Has_VDJ <- factor(Merged.SeuratObj$Has_VDJ, levels=c('GEX', 'GEX+VDJ'))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# UMAP embeddings
umap_embeddings <- as.data.frame(
  Merged.SeuratObj@reductions[["h_umap"]]@cell.embeddings
)
colnames(umap_embeddings)[1:2] <- c("humap_1", "humap_2")
umap_embeddings$cell <- rownames(umap_embeddings)

# Add Has_VDJ from metadata
md <- Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data
umap_embeddings$Has_VDJ <- md[umap_embeddings$cell, "Has_VDJ"]

# Subsets
bg_cells  <- umap_embeddings[umap_embeddings$Has_VDJ == "GEX", , drop = FALSE]
top_cells <- umap_embeddings[umap_embeddings$Has_VDJ == "GEX+VDJ", , drop = FALSE]

# Counts for subtitle
n_top <- nrow(top_cells)
n_bg  <- nrow(bg_cells)
n_tot <- nrow(umap_embeddings)

plot <- ggplot() +
  # Background: GEX
  geom_point(
    data = bg_cells,
    aes(humap_1, humap_2),
    color = "#d6d6d6",
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 1
  ) +
  # Top: GEX+VDJ
  geom_point(
    data = top_cells,
    aes(humap_1, humap_2),
    shape  = 21,
    fill   = "steelblue4",
    colour = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    size   = 1.7,
    alpha  = 0.95
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  ggtitle(
    "VDJ distribution",
    paste0("GEX+VDJ: ", n_top, " | GEX: ", n_bg, " | Total: ", n_tot)
  )

print(plot)

# Save
png(
  filename = file.path(results_folder, "Phenotype", "UMAP_ALL_Has_VDJ_GEX_vs_GEXplusVDJ.png"),
  width = 9*0.70,
  height = 9*0.75,
  res = 300,
  units = "in",
  type = "cairo"
)
print(plot)
dev.off()

pdf(
  file = file.path(results_folder, "Phenotype", "UMAP_ALL_Has_VDJ_GEX_vs_GEXplusVDJ.pdf"),
  width = 9*0.70,
  height = 9*0.75
)
print(plot)
dev.off()

```

## - Markers expression dotplot

```{r}
# ---- packages ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Seurat)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(dplyr)
    library(ggdendro)
    library(scales)
    library(grid)
    library(gtable)
    library(ggtext)
})

# ---- genes ----
genes <- c(
    'IL4R','ISG15','CD24','CR2','MME','CD1C','FCRL3','FCRL4','IL10RB',
    'CXCR3','CXCR5','CD5','APOD','ABCA6','ABCA9','CTLA4','CD27','IGHG1',
    'MKI67','BACH1','ZBTB16','MX1','FAS','SOX5','TBX21','STAT3','ZEB2',
    'ZBTB32','JUN','FOSB','NR4A1','EGR1','LEF1','XBP1','PRDM1'
)

genes_use <- intersect(genes, rownames(Merged.SeuratObj))
missing <- setdiff(genes, genes_use)
if (length(missing) > 0) message("Missing genes (not in object): ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
stopifnot(length(genes_use) > 1)

pad <- 0.6

# -------------------------------------------------
# Build DotPlot ONCE
# -------------------------------------------------
dp_raw <- DotPlot(
    Merged.SeuratObj,
    group.by  = "Celltype",
    assay     = "SCT",
    scale.by  = "radius",
    dot.scale = 5,
    features  = genes_use
)$data %>%
    mutate(
        features.plot = trimws(as.character(features.plot)),
        id            = trimws(as.character(id))
    )

celltypes_dp <- sort(unique(dp_raw$id))
celltypes_dp <- celltypes_dp[!is.na(celltypes_dp) & celltypes_dp != ""]
stopifnot(length(celltypes_dp) > 1)

genes_dp <- intersect(genes_use, sort(unique(dp_raw$features.plot)))
stopifnot(length(genes_dp) > 1)

# -------------------------------------------------
# AverageExpression
# -------------------------------------------------
avg_mat <- AverageExpression(
    Merged.SeuratObj,
    features = genes_dp,
    group.by = "Celltype",
    assay    = "SCT"
)$SCT

colnames(avg_mat) <- trimws(colnames(avg_mat))
rownames(avg_mat) <- trimws(rownames(avg_mat))

missing_in_avg <- setdiff(celltypes_dp, colnames(avg_mat))
extra_in_avg   <- setdiff(colnames(avg_mat), celltypes_dp)
if (length(missing_in_avg) > 0 || length(extra_in_avg) > 0) {
    stop("Mismatch between DotPlot celltypes and AverageExpression columns.")
}

avg_mat <- avg_mat[genes_dp, celltypes_dp, drop = FALSE]
avg_scaled <- t(scale(t(avg_mat)))
avg_scaled[is.na(avg_scaled)] <- 0

# -------------------------------------------------
# Cluster
# -------------------------------------------------
hc_genes <- hclust(dist(avg_scaled), method = "ward.D2")
d_genes  <- as.dendrogram(hc_genes)

hc_ct <- hclust(dist(t(avg_scaled)), method = "ward.D2")
d_ct  <- as.dendrogram(hc_ct)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Leaf positions from dendro_data
# -------------------------------------------------
dd_g <- ggdendro::dendro_data(d_genes, type = "rectangle")
dd_c <- ggdendro::dendro_data(d_ct,    type = "rectangle")

gene_leaves <- dd_g$labels %>%
    mutate(label = trimws(as.character(label))) %>%
    arrange(x)
gene_order <- gene_leaves$label
gene_pos   <- setNames(gene_leaves$x, gene_leaves$label)
n_genes    <- length(gene_order)

ct_leaves <- dd_c$labels %>%
    mutate(label = trimws(as.character(label))) %>%
    arrange(x)
celltype_order <- ct_leaves$label
ct_pos         <- setNames(ct_leaves$x, ct_leaves$label)
n_ct           <- length(celltype_order)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Dot plot data
# -------------------------------------------------
dp <- dp_raw %>%
    filter(features.plot %in% gene_order, id %in% celltype_order) %>%
    mutate(
        x = gene_pos[features.plot],
        y = ct_pos[id],
        stroke_w = scales::rescale(pct.exp, to = c(0.16, 1.04), from = c(0, 100))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y))

vlines <- data.frame(xv = head(sort(gene_pos), -1) + diff(sort(gene_pos)) / 2)
hlines <- data.frame(yv = head(sort(ct_pos), -1)   + diff(sort(ct_pos)) / 2)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Shared axis limits
# -------------------------------------------------
x_lim <- c(min(gene_pos) - pad, max(gene_pos) + pad)
y_lim <- c(min(ct_pos)   - pad, max(ct_pos)   + pad)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Main dot plot
# -------------------------------------------------
DotP <- ggplot(dp, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_vline(
        data = vlines, aes(xintercept = xv),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_hline(
        data = hlines, aes(yintercept = yv),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_point(
        aes(size = pct.exp, fill = avg.exp.scaled, stroke = stroke_w),
        shape = 21, colour = "black", alpha = 1
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = gradient_exp) +
    scale_size(
        limits = c(0, 100),
        breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
        labels = function(z) paste0(z, "%")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = gene_pos,
        labels = paste0("*", names(gene_pos), "*"),
        limits = x_lim,
        expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = ct_pos,
        labels = names(ct_pos),
        limits = y_lim,
        expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12, base_line_size = 0.2) +
    theme(
        text         = element_text(family = "sans"),
        plot.margin  = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
        axis.title   = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x  = ggtext::element_markdown(
            angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10,
            family = "sans"
        ),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans"),
        axis.line    = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks   = element_blank(),
        legend.position      = "bottom",
        legend.justification = "center",
        legend.direction     = "horizontal",
        legend.box           = "horizontal",
        legend.box.just      = "top",
        legend.spacing.x     = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.box.spacing   = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.margin        = margin(t = 5, b = 5, l = 0, r = 0),
        legend.text          = element_text(size = 9, family = "sans"),
        legend.title         = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans"),
        legend.key.size      = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.key.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm")
    ) +
    guides(
        fill = guide_colorbar(
            title = "Scaled Expression",
            title.position = "top",
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            barwidth  = unit(4, "cm"),
            barheight = unit(0.35, "cm"),
            ticks.linewidth = 0.3,
            frame.colour = "black",
            frame.linewidth = 0.3,
            order = 2
        ),
        size = guide_legend(
            title = "Percent Expressing",
            title.position = "top",
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            nrow = 1,
            byrow = TRUE,
            override.aes = list(stroke = 0.5, fill = "grey70"),
            order = 1
        )
    )

# -------------------------------------------------
# Convert to gtable
# -------------------------------------------------
g_dot <- ggplotGrob(DotP)

panel_idx <- which(g_dot$layout$name == "panel")
panel_t   <- g_dot$layout$t[panel_idx]
panel_b   <- g_dot$layout$b[panel_idx]
panel_l   <- g_dot$layout$l[panel_idx]
panel_r   <- g_dot$layout$r[panel_idx]

# -------------------------------------------------
# Top dendrogram as raw grid grob
# -------------------------------------------------
dend_top_grob <- gTree(
    children = gList(
        segmentsGrob(
            x0 = unit(rescale(dd_g$segments$x,    from = x_lim), "npc"),
            y0 = unit(rescale(dd_g$segments$y,    from = c(0, max(dd_g$segments$y))), "npc"),
            x1 = unit(rescale(dd_g$segments$xend, from = x_lim), "npc"),
            y1 = unit(rescale(dd_g$segments$yend, from = c(0, max(dd_g$segments$y))), "npc"),
            gp = gpar(lwd = 0.8)
        )
    )
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Right dendrogram as raw grid grob
# -------------------------------------------------
dend_right_grob <- gTree(
    children = gList(
        segmentsGrob(
            x0 = unit(rescale(dd_c$segments$y,    from = c(0, max(dd_c$segments$y))), "npc"),
            y0 = unit(rescale(dd_c$segments$x,    from = y_lim), "npc"),
            x1 = unit(rescale(dd_c$segments$yend, from = c(0, max(dd_c$segments$y))), "npc"),
            y1 = unit(rescale(dd_c$segments$xend, from = y_lim), "npc"),
            gp = gpar(lwd = 0.8)
        )
    )
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Add dendrograms to the dot plot gtable
# -------------------------------------------------

# Add padding column on the left
g_combined <- gtable_add_cols(g_dot, widths = unit(0.1, "in"), pos = 0)

# Add spacer row, dendrogram row, and padding row on top
g_combined <- gtable_add_rows(g_combined, heights = unit(0.1, "in"), pos = 0)
g_combined <- gtable_add_rows(g_combined, heights = unit(1.8, "in"), pos = 0)
g_combined <- gtable_add_rows(g_combined, heights = unit(0.1, "in"), pos = 0)

# panel_l shifted by +1 due to left padding column
g_combined <- gtable_add_grob(
    g_combined,
    dend_top_grob,
    t = 2, b = 2,
    l = panel_l + 1, r = panel_r + 1,
    name = "dend_top"
)

# Add spacer column, dendrogram column, and padding column on right
g_combined <- gtable_add_cols(g_combined, widths = unit(0.1, "in"), pos = -1)
g_combined <- gtable_add_cols(g_combined, widths = unit(0.8, "in"), pos = -1)
g_combined <- gtable_add_cols(g_combined, widths = unit(0.1, "in"), pos = -1)

# panel rows shifted by +3, panel cols shifted by +1
g_combined <- gtable_add_grob(
    g_combined,
    dend_right_grob,
    t = panel_t + 3, b = panel_b + 3,
    l = ncol(g_combined) - 1, r = ncol(g_combined) - 1,
    name = "dend_right"
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Save
# -------------------------------------------------
dir.create(file.path(results_folder, "Phenotype"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

png(
    file.path(results_folder, "Phenotype", "DotPlot_topDendro_rightDendro_yAxisMatchesDendrogram.png"),
    width = 12, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300, type = "cairo"
)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(g_combined)
dev.off()

pdf(
    file.path(results_folder, "Phenotype", "DotPlot_topDendro_rightDendro_yAxisMatchesDendrogram.pdf"),
    width = 12, height = 6
)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(g_combined)
dev.off()

message("Celltype order used on Y:\n", paste(celltype_order, collapse = ", "))
message("Gene order used on X:\n", paste(gene_order, collapse = ", "))
```
